description: The creature has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the creature's allies is within 5 feet of the target and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.
_comment: SRD 5.2.1 (CC-BY-4.0), Wolf and Giant Rat. An ally at 0 Hit Points doesn't count, since it is Unconscious and so Incapacitated.
